title: PUT /api/pairing/clients/{client_id}/profile (body)
description: Assign a profile to a device. Adjustments of rules the new profile fixes are deleted; discard_overrides deletes all. A guest device cannot get a profile with parental controls (422 profile.guest_child_protection). When the device stops holding a Home Assistant key (the new profile is on Hub only without remote access) the hub withdraws the HA token (rotation, the device reads and switches through the hub); when it starts holding one, it gets its own HA token again. Answer: paired-client.json; ?dry_run=true: profile-preview.response.json.
